“We‍ want to inform the⁤ entire community that our daughter Valentina Gilabert⁢ is in the process of recovery after what happened,” they explained in the press release recovered by⁢ N+ .
doctors have taken a important⁣ step by removing⁢ the⁢ sedation⁣ that kept her in an induced coma. Valentina is now⁢ gradually regaining⁣ consciousness and has been transferred to ​an ⁢intermediate ⁤therapy unit. This development has brought⁢ renewed hope to her family ‍and friends.

He revealed that she has‍ undergone a total of ⁣nine⁣ surgeries ,​ all​ of which have been triumphant.
“Operations have come out successfully, (we have⁣ done) about eight or ‍nine operations,” David Muri⁢ stated in ‍an interview with ‍ Sale . The surgeries have targeted various ‍organs, reflecting the‍ extensive nature of her injuries.
Recovery of Vital Functions Along with the surgeries, ⁢Valentina has made significant strides in ‍recovering essential functions. She has regained the ability to ‍speak and swallow, which are critical steps toward her overall recovery. Though, she still requires ‌ongoing medical care, especially for drainage in both⁢ lungs due to the severity ‍of her injuries.
